'''Kandhar''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who led a [[Kandhar's White Maw faction|faction]] of the [[White Maw]], a pirate gang based on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] at the start of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], he allied with the Empire in an attempt to take over the White Maw.

==Biography==
The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Kandhar was a member of the [[White Maw]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang based on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. By<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he led his own [[Kandhar's White Maw faction|group]] in the White Maw, and was the rival of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Shai Tenna]], another White Maw pirate. By that year, Kandhar had made an alliance with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In return for their help in ousting the White Maw's [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] leaders, Kandhar and his men would work for the Empire. Through his alliance with the Empire, Kandhar also received [[cold-weather droid]]s, which pleased the Gen'Dai, and angered Shai Tenna.<ref name="TOR" />

In 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Kandhar and some of his men—[[Risold]], [[Feldon (Zabrak)|Feldon]], and [[Halrii]]—met with Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Tarkus]] in the [[Tromper Crags mineral mine]] on Hoth. Tarkus informed him that the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] known as the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] had agreed to the terms of the deal. However, the meeting was interrupted by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Voidhound|smuggler]] sent by Shai Tenna. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] revealed to Khandar's pirates that his deal would bring them under the Empire's control, and they revolted. In the ensuing [[Skirmish in the Tromper Crags Mineral Mine (Voidhound)|skirmish]], Kandhar and the Imperials were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />
